title: docs(auth): send newPassword in the reset-password example
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_
Fixes #29852
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：认证文档「Reset Password with Token」示例的请求体字段从 `password` 改为 `newPassword`，仅此一行。
- 为什么改：重置密码接口要求 `newPassword`，照文档复制的请求会被 400 拒绝，用户无法完成密码重置；同页其余重置/验证示例已逐一对照接口校验，均正确。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档改动，不触任何运行时代码与发布包；回滚即还原这一行。
- 先看：`content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` 第 305 行（唯一改动）。
- 两分钟验证：`grep -n "newPassword: 'newSecurePassword456'" content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`，应看到第 305 行一条命中。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`, "Reset Password with Token": the body sent to `POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password` now carries `newPassword` instead of `password`. The door's body schema is better-auth 1.7.12 `resetPassword` (`dist/api/routes/password.mjs`): `newPassword: z.string()` required, `token: z.string().optional()`. Sent as previously documented the door answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (`[body.newPassword] ... received undefined`).

The other reset and verification examples on the page were each checked against the body or query schema their door actually parses (installed better-auth 1.7.12, plus this repo's `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` mounts where one fronts the door). All match, so none changed:

| Example | Door schema read | Verdict |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Request Password Reset `{ email }` | better-auth `requestPasswordReset`: `email` required, `redirectTo` optional | matches |
| Reset Password with Token | better-auth `resetPassword`: `newPassword` required, `token` optional | **fixed** (`password` → `newPassword`) |
| Setting a first local password `{ newPassword }` | `plugin-auth/src/set-initial-password.ts`: reads `newPassword` | matches |
| Send Verification Email (no body, bearer) | better-auth requires `email`, but `plugin-auth/src/send-verification-email.ts` (mounted in `auth-plugin.ts`) defaults it to the signed-in caller's email | matches |
| Verify Email `?token=` | better-auth `verifyEmail` query: `token` required, `callbackURL` optional | matches |
| Phone `send-otp` `{ phoneNumber }` | `phone-number/routes.mjs` `sendPhoneNumberOTPBodySchema` | matches |
| Phone `verify` `{ phoneNumber, code }` | `verifyPhoneNumberBodySchema` | matches |
| Phone `request-password-reset` `{ phoneNumber }` | `requestPasswordResetPhoneNumberBodySchema` | matches |
| Phone `reset-password` `{ phoneNumber, otp, newPassword }` | `resetPasswordPhoneNumberBodySchema` | matches |
| 2FA `verify-totp` `{ code }` | `two-factor/totp/index.mjs` `verifyTOTPBodySchema`: `code` required, `trustDevice` optional | matches |
| Magic link `verify?token=` | `magic-link/index.mjs` `magicLinkVerifyQuerySchema`: `token` required | matches |

## Tests

Docs only. No test pins this example: the block's `os:check` marker makes `check:skill-examples` type-check it with `tsc`, and `JSON.stringify` takes any object, so that gate cannot see a wrong field name. It still type-checks after the change.

## Acceptance notes

- The `os:check` gate proves a marked fetch example compiles, not that its body matches the door. Noted, not filed.

## Verification

Gate readings are in the `os-dev-report` comment on #29852 (derived by `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, every exit code captured before any pipe).
